devdoc.details: - All state changes are restricted to the configured Hook via onlyHook. - Units are denominated in the underlying asset units used by the Vault behind the Hook. - feePercent is expressed in basis points (BPS), where 10_000 = 100%.

returns._0: fee Amount of fees to be transferred by the caller (asset units).

params._hook: The Hook contract authorized to call this module.

onDeposit(uint256).details: Increases both portfolioValue and highWaterMark by assets.

onWithdraw(uint256).details: Decreases both portfolioValue and highWaterMark by assets.

setFee(uint256).details: No bounds checking; callers should validate acceptable ranges at a higher layer.

params.newFee: New fee in basis points, where 10_000 = 100%.

updatePortfolioValue(uint256).details: - If newValue > highWaterMark, accrue fee on the delta and raise highWaterMark to newValue. - Always sets portfolioValue = newValue.

params.newValue: New portfolio value in asset units.

feePercent.details: 10_000 = 100%. Applied only to gains above the current high-water mark.

highWaterMark.details: Used to compute performance fees when portfolio value increases.

portfolioValue.details: Updated on deposits, withdrawals, or explicit revaluation.

devdoc.title: High-water-mark valuation and performance fee accrual module

claimFee().notice: Claim all accrued fees and reset the accumulator.

constructor.notice: Create a valuation module tied to a specific Hook.

feeAccrued().notice: Accrued, unclaimed fee amount in asset units.

feePercent().notice: Performance fee percentage in basis points (BPS).

highWaterMark().notice: Current high-water mark of the portfolio value.

hook().notice: Authorized caller (the Hook) that drives valuation updates and fee accrual.

onDeposit(uint256).notice: Notify the module of an asset deposit increasing portfolio value.

onWithdraw(uint256).notice: Notify the module of an asset withdrawal decreasing portfolio value.

portfolioValue().notice: Last reported portfolio value in asset units.

updatePortfolioValue(uint256).notice: Update the portfolio value and accrue performance fees vs. the high-water mark.

userdoc.notice: Tracks portfolio value and accrues performance fees above a high-water mark for a single Hook.
